freeze_rule: Do not disclose to implementation lanes until candidate source and executable hash frozen.
retirement: Reveal at final evaluation, retain exact replay content/hash with final evidence; review at candidate freeze or campaign closeout.

cases.name: conntrack partially missing pair
cases.change: In guest-private mount namespace hide only nf_conntrack_max while genuine nf_conntrack_count remains visible; separately prove subsystem loaded and existing live flows.
cases.oracle: UNKNOWN unless another supported positive yields DEGRADED. A missing member cannot establish subsystem absence.

cases.name: mounted path shadowing
cases.change: Guest mounts two small ext4 filesystems successively on the same pathname; lower mount is critical, visible upper mount ample. Preserve mount IDs, source devices and statvfs by open directory handles.
cases.oracle: The evaluator must not claim capacity measured for both device identities from df against the one visible pathname. UNKNOWN or positive DEGRADED if corresponding evidence retained; CLEAR requires explicit defensible visible-domain scope.

cases.name: required source failure plus retained counter positive
cases.change: Guest-local traffic raises an independently bracketed RX/TX drop counter; deny only one different counter source in process namespace.
cases.oracle: DEGRADED with positive delta and explicit incomplete evidence. UNKNOWN loses required positive precedence; CLEAR false.
cases.class: compound real drop plus evidence fixture

cases.name: benign EDAC log vocabulary
cases.change: Use fresh VM without EDAC; produce a real guest-kernel benign EDAC informational event where feasible (module initialization failure without memory corruption), otherwise classify as command substitution and preserve exact benign message provenance.
cases.oracle: memrot UNKNOWN without positive integrity evidence; broad EDAC substring cannot alone establish hardware degradation for benign capability/setup messages. Actual event semantics must be independently checked.
cases.class: driver message or explicitly labeled substitution

cases.name: equal-name interface replacement
cases.change: Replace guest veth during sample with a new same-named veth, restoring routes; preserve ifindex event history and ensure counters monotonic by controlled traffic.
cases.oracle: No CLEAR based on combining distinct interface generations unless continuity justified. UNKNOWN acceptable; trace must prove replacement between actual samples.

cases.name: human required evidence limitation
cases.change: Guest missing defaults gives supported DEGRADED while log access denied; execute default human CLI and JSON separately under stable state.
cases.oracle: Both must disclose missing required log evidence sufficiently to preserve envelope; positive route evidence cannot erase limitation. Compare semantic bounds, not exact timestamps.
